title: Hamiltonian s–t paths in solid grid graphs are decidable in polynomial time
summary: A computable algorithm, decideHamPath, that decides whether a solid grid graph (a finite set of lattice points with no holes, with an edge between points at distance 1) has a Hamiltonian path between two given distinct points, with a Lean 4 proof that it is correct. The problem was posed by Itai, Papadimitriou and Szwarcfiter (1982).
